guard_streams.write_limit: The Spring 2026 report is an aggregate January 2026 snapshot and its downloadable coverage file still requires exact archive, schema, premises-identity and current-orderability validation before parcel promotion.

facts.detail: Ofcom published the Spring 2026 update on 13 May 2026.
The report provides a fixed and mobile network snapshot as of January 2026.
It is an interim update to Connected Nations 2025, which used July 2025 data.
Fixed broadband reporting covers fixed-line and fixed wireless access networks.
The report also covers take-up of full-fibre services.
Decent broadband is defined as at least 10 Mbit/s download and 1 Mbit/s upload.
The report says only 4,000 premises lacked access to affordable decent broadband.
Premises unable to access decent broadband from fixed line or FWA fell to 39,000 from 44,000.
Predicted good 4G geographic coverage reached 84% from all MNOs and remained 96% from at least one MNO.
Ofcom used the collected data to update its broadband and mobile coverage checkers.

guard_streams.write_limit: Connected Nations 2025 is an annual aggregate report and publication hub; it cannot by itself establish exact current selected-parcel availability, orderability or measured speed.

facts.detail: Ofcom published Connected Nations 2025 on 19 November 2025.
Connected Nations is Ofcom's annual report on broadband and mobile service availability.
The report covers availability of broadband services across the UK.
The report also covers availability of mobile services.
It includes rollout of fixed full-fibre networks.
It includes rollout of mobile 5G networks.
The publication links a UK-wide report.
Separate reports are available for each UK nation.
An interactive report provides access to area- and service-specific data.
The publication links FAQs, a methodology annex and data downloads.

guard_streams.write_limit: The 2025 download catalogue describes historical files and documentation. Exact file version, schema, snapshot and parcel identity must be validated before any current parcel write.

facts.detail: Ofcom published the 2025 download catalogue on 19 November 2025.
The catalogue contains data underpinning Connected Nations 2025.
Ofcom says the data supports year-on-year infrastructure comparisons.
The catalogue includes a fixed-broadband coverage download.
It includes full-fibre take-up for local and unitary authorities.
An about-data document accompanies fixed coverage and take-up.
The catalogue includes fixed-broadband performance data.
A separate about-data document accompanies fixed performance.
The catalogue includes mobile coverage data.
Ofcom directs data questions and feedback to its Connected Nations data team.
